== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added a September 2003 forum suggestion, the June 2004 Rhode Island States announcement, signature claims and an 8 January 2005 results row. Sources (Players Committee forum, each cited with a Preserved copy on the article):
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33226#33226 New Tournament Advocate] (post 33226, Pistone84, 17 September 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040112231657/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36534%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33236#33236 New Tournament Advocate] (post 33236, Pistone84, 17 September 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040112231657/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36534%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48313#48313 RI States July 17th!!!] (post 48313, Pistone84, 29 June 2004; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041210023513/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48313%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51794#51794 Can someone post a list of those who qualified for day 2?] (post 51794, Pistone84, 1 August 2004; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230643/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3789%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59872#59872 January 8th 2005.  Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier] (post 59872, CRingwell, 11 January 2005; [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive])
=== Missing data ===
* The 2003 and 2004 State Championship titles come only from his forum signature, so they are in prose (with capture dates) and not in the results table. "2003 Betashyyyk Champion" names an event the wiki does not have.
* The Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier (8 January 2005, Neutral Ground) has no event page yet; the row is unlinked.
* His personal e-mail address in post 48313 was left out.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The gap list saw a conflict between a 12 April 2003 post signed "2003 Massachusetts State Champion" and the 19 July 2003 date of [[2003 Massachusetts State Championship]]. Signatures render at capture time (that post was captured June 2004), so there is no conflict.
* In the 8 January 2005 standings post, a = Light and b = Dark, but Pistone's line lists Maul Drain Deck as a and Throne Room Mains as b. The row puts Throne Room Mains (a Light Side deck) under Light and Maul Drain Deck under Dark.
